source_snapshot.criteria: Link can successfully execute L1 transitions without error
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 60 attended and 1440 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual but treats L1 as a generic link loop and omits substate, residency and latency.

old_problem: Returning to an active link does not prove entry into base L1 or an L1 substate, sufficient residency, deterministic wake, acceptable exit latency, or absence of transient error. ASPM ownership and policy restoration were also unspecified.
disposition_reason: The source fixes the power-management transition class, count and no-error outcome. Exact supported L1 state, policy owner, idle/residency/wake/latency contract, tool, topology, ledger and restoration are safe Project Configuration. This distinguishes L1 from retrain and removes review Pending without guessing a substate.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2119, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2120 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00041-V002 / 4461cfb2e28a0a63 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
L1 is a PCIe power-management entry/exit transaction, not a speed retrain or D3 device-power transition; preserve exactly 10,000 L1 cycles.
Bind the supported target as L1 versus L1.1/L1.2, ASPM ownership, complete link path, idle/workload condition, minimum residency, wake stimulus and exit-latency ceiling.
For each cycle record entry request, confirmed state/residency, wake stimulus, exit time, restored L0 generation/width/enumeration, and fresh error/platform-health deltas before the next cycle.
A final active link, setup action, incomplete entry/exit, retry or unproven counter is not a successful count; compressed evidence must be lossless and gap-detecting.
Stop on missed entry/residency, wake timeout, link loss/downtrain, endpoint disappearance, disqualifying AER/reset, policy drift, evidence gap or safety anomaly.
Preserve first fault, restore policy only by signed method and never force an unsupported state or retry automatically.
No ASPM/L1 policy change, LTSSM/NVQual, link query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: State- and latency-verified 10,000-cycle PCIe L1 entry/exit soak
test_case.purpose: Prove exactly 10,000 approved L1 power-management entries and exits on the mapped link, including observable residency, bounded wake latency, restored link state and no disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual L1 configuration compatible with platform firmware/driver
Mapped root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint/GPU/sibling topology and bilateral L1/L1SS capabilities
Approved ASPM owner, L1/L1.1/L1.2 target, idle condition, residency, wake stimulus, latency and link/error rules
10,000-entry durable state/timing ledger with first-fault interlock and policy-restoration audit
Dedicated idle SUT, console, stable power/cooling and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve capability/policy/link/error/health baselines; after point approval execute only the pinned L1 entry/exit method for entries 1..10000. Durably record intended entry, confirmed state/residency, approved wake, exit latency, restored link/enumeration and error/health deltas before enabling the next cycle. Stop on first anomaly or gap; do not force or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 10,000 entries prove the approved L1 state was reached for required residency and exited within latency to the required L0 generation/width with endpoint/siblings healthy, no disqualifying errors, and final ASPM policy restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until substate, policy owner, capability, entry/residency/wake/latency/link/error contract, ledger and recovery are approved. PASS requires 10,000 complete accepted cycles. FAIL on missed state/residency, late/failed wake, link/device loss/downtrain, policy drift, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; retries do not count.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until bilateral capability, exact L1 target/policy, wake/latency acceptance, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Never force unsupported L1SS or mutate policy outside the approved owner.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console and explicit 10,000-cycle authorization.
Commit each state/timing result and stop without retry at the first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval, tool/configuration, topology and L1/L1SS capability
Initial ASPM/L1 policy plus entry/residency/wake/latency/link/error contract
Gap-detecting ledger 1..10000 with state and entry/exit timestamps, latency and disposition
Tool restart, sample-loss, timestamp and artifact-integrity audit
First-fault/recovery or clean restored policy/final link state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first missed entry/residency, failed/late wake, link/device loss/downtrain, policy drift, disqualifying error/reset or evidence gap, inhibit later cycles and preserve the event. Restore policy only by the signed method; do not retry and quarantine if link/endpoint/host health is not restored.
